extracted.intended_audience: Institutional eRA Commons administrators (Signing Officials, Account Administrators, Business Officials), delegated institutional users, and SO/AA staff who register organizations and manage accounts/delegations
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance and system rules for registering organizations in NIH eRA Commons, creating and managing user accounts, and granting/revoking delegation authorities (e.g., Progress Report, Sponsor, PPF, xTrain). Covers required field constraints, verification/approval workflow, and admin-module delegation workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Valid DUNS number required
rubrics_metrics.description: You must have a valid and verifiable Dunn and Bradstreet (DUNS) number before proceeding with the registration process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your institution does not have a valid DUNS number, obtain one at http://fedgov.dnb.com/webform. More information at http://www.dnb.com/us/.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required fields and field constraints for institution registration
rubrics_metrics.description: All fields followed by a red asterisk (*) are required. A minimum of one address line (Street 1) is required. The Institution Name may contain a maximum of 100 characters. An Official’s Title may contain a maximum of 240 characters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify all entered information is correct before selecting Save. The system displays an Online Registration screen and provides success/confirmation notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Username rules
rubrics_metrics.description: The User Name must have a minimum of six (6) characters (numbers and letters can be combined but no spaces can be used). Usernames may not exceed the maximum of twenty (20) characters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow these constraints when entering the account User ID; system enforces uniqueness and length/character rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: AA position optional during registration
rubrics_metrics.description: The AA position and information is optional. When completing information for the AA, fill in the required account information fields and submit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If AA account is created at same time as SO, separate emails are sent to AA (user name and temporary password). Emails sent to the SO do not include AA credentials.

rubrics_metrics.name: DUNS format/meaning
rubrics_metrics.description: The DUNS Number is a unique nine-digit identification for single business entities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the institution's single-business-entity DUNS number when registering; system relies on it for organization identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Email verification and NIH review for registration
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH sends an address confirmation e-mail to the designated SO; the SO must click the e-mail hyperlink to verify the SO e-mail address. NIH reviews the registration (pending approval) and sends a second email stating the status (approved or rejected).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If rejected, the email notifies you of the reason. If approved, select the hyperlink in the e-mail to confirm registration and open the IPF Assignment View.

rubrics_metrics.name: IPF assignment and activation steps
rubrics_metrics.description: After SO confirms the Registration request in the IPF Assignment View, click Yes. After confirmation, an email is sent containing the User ID and temporary password. The SO must re-log in to Commons and change the password, then click Accept to electronically sign the registration request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once the SO has electronically signed the registration request, the organization will be active in Commons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admin module access depends on user role
rubrics_metrics.description: All Commons users have access to the Admin module; however, your role determines what you can and cannot do within the module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Admin module houses features used to perform Account Management and Delegations; available actions vary by role.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accounts tab capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: The Accounts tab contains options for creating, searching, and updating user accounts (Manage Accounts, Advanced Search, Change Password).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the Account Management System's Online Help for more info. Use Manage Accounts to create/manage users; Advanced Search helps locate users; Change Password for password management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advanced Search behavior and constraints
rubrics_metrics.description: Advanced Search defaults to 'Search within your institution' (checked) and will only search records within your institution unless unchecked. The percent sign (%) may be used as a wildcard (e.g., Sm%). When searching outside your organization, you must include the Last Name or Commons ID in your search criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search results may be paginated; use Prev/Next/All links to navigate. The Clear button clears parameters and results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account search results fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Account search results include User Name, User ID, Email Address, Account Status, Role, CS Eligibility Details, Address, and Institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The CS Eligibility Details column displays a No or Yes link indicating Continuous Submission Eligibility status; select link to view that PI's Continuous Submission Eligibility screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who may create PD/PI accounts
rubrics_metrics.description: PD/PIs cannot create their own accounts. Only an SO or AA Commons user can create this account (also BO may have creation privileges per role).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Manage Accounts/Create Account flow; the Create Account button is disabled until a search is performed to avoid duplicate accounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create Account personal information requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: On the Create Account screen, enter the Personal Information fields. Note that all fields except Middle Name are required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: User Type should default to Commons; Organization should default to your own but can be changed via lookup. Use percent sign (%) wildcard when searching organization names. After entering personal info, assign role(s) via Role lookup and Add; Save to complete.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation concept and revocability
rubrics_metrics.description: Delegation: granting (and revoking) authority to other Commons users to perform specific functions (enter/process grant info, update PPF, submit RPPR, work with specific modules). Delegations are not permanent and can be revoked at any time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delegation may be on behalf of another user or direct (against your own account). Emails notify users of granted or revoked authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation authorities table (who can delegate what to whom)
rubrics_metrics.description: A table lists types of delegation authorities (e.g., Progress Report, Sponsor, Submit, Status, PPF, xTrain), who may grant them (e.g., SO, AA, AO, PI, SO/BO) and who may receive them (e.g., PI, ASST, any active user).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the Delegation Authorities table to determine permitted delegations for your role and the recipient role.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegate Progress Report authority (on behalf of another user)
rubrics_metrics.description: To delegate Progress Report authority on behalf of a PI: from Admin > Delegations choose Delegate Progress Report; search for the PI (Commons ID, Last, First, Middle - % wildcard allowed), select the PI, then search for the delegatee, select that user, check the Progress Report box, and Save.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selecting Cancel cancels action. After saving, Commons grants Progress Report authority and sends an email informing the delegated user; that user can then submit progress reports for the selected PI. The PI can view the delegated user under My Current Delegations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegate Sponsor authority (on behalf of another user)
rubrics_metrics.description: To delegate Sponsor authority on behalf of a Sponsor: from Admin > Delegations choose Delegate Sponsor; search for the Sponsor (criteria and % wildcard allowed), select the Sponsor, then search for the ASST user, select them, mark the Sponsor checkbox, and Save.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After saving, Commons grants the Sponsor authority and emails the ASST; the ASST can then perform xTrain functions for the selected Sponsor. Cancel aborts the action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revoke authority on behalf of another user
rubrics_metrics.description: To revoke Progress Report or Sponsor authority on behalf of another user: Admin > Delegations > select Delegate Progress Report or Delegate Sponsor, search for the delegator, select the user, then search for the delegatee, unmark the authority checkbox, and Save.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After saving, the authority is unmarked and Commons emails the user informing them they no longer have that authority; they no longer appear in My Current Delegations for that PI/Sponsor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional delegation for Submit Progress Report authority
rubrics_metrics.description: Signing Officials and Business Officials may delegate authority to PIs within their institutions to allow those PIs to submit RPPR and FPR electronically to NIH. Granting and revoking Submit authority is managed through the My Delegations screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Institution Delegation link to view Candidates and Current Submit Progress Report Delegations tables. Candidates table includes Select All and Clear All buttons; use checkboxes to select users and Grant Delegation(s) to proceed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certification and acceptance required when granting institutional delegation
rubrics_metrics.description: When granting Submit Progress Report authority, the Institution Delegations screen displays a certification and acceptance agreement which the delegating official must certify.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You must select the I Agree button to certify: "I certify that the statements herein are true, complete, and accurate to the best of my knowledge, and accept the obligation to comply with Public Health Services terms and conditions if a grant is awarded as a result of this application. I am aware that any false, fictitious, or fraudulent statements or claims may subject me to criminal, civil, or administrative penalties." Cancel returns without saving.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revoking institutional Submit Progress Report authority
rubrics_metrics.description: To revoke Institutional Submit Progress Report authority: Admin > Delegations > Institution Delegation, use the Current Submit Progress Report Delegations table to select users (checkboxes or Select All), then Revoke Delegation(s) and confirm by selecting I Agree.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A confirmation message lists Name, Title, Address of selected users. After confirmation, Commons revokes authority, emails users, and moves names back to the Candidates table.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct delegations (delegating authority against your own account)
rubrics_metrics.description: Some Commons users can delegate authority directly to another Commons user so that user can access features (e.g., FCOI) or access features of the delegator's own account (e.g., Personal Profile). Depending on your role, available direct delegations include: Delegate Progress Report, Delegate Status, Delegate PPF, Delegate xTrain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Availability of each authority for delegation differs depending on the grantor's role and the recipient's role; see Delegation Authorities table for specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search/Add Delegate process and constraints
rubrics_metrics.description: To delegate authority against your account or directly to another user: Admin > Delegations > Search or Add Delegate. Search parameters include Commons ID, Last, First, Middle, and Role(s) (roles displayed in drop-down; hold CTRL to select multiple). The percent sign (%) may be used as a wildcard.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Matching users display with their current delegated authorities (checkboxes). Only available authorities for delegation display. Select the user, mark the authority checkboxes (Select All available), and Save. Commons grants specified authority and emails the selected users; Search Results update to show assigned authorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Edit existing delegations for your account
rubrics_metrics.description: To edit delegations already assigned to users for your account: Admin > Delegations, click Select for a user in My Current Delegations; the Delegate Authority screen shows authorities with marked checkboxes indicating granted authorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Edit by marking or unmarking checkboxes to add or revoke authorities; select Save to save changes. Cancel returns without saving. Commons emails users informing them of changes; if all authorities revoked, user no longer appears in the table.

rubrics_metrics.name: Remove delegations (unassign authorities)
rubrics_metrics.description: To remove delegations assigned to users for your account: Admin > Delegations, Select the user, uncheck appropriate authority checkbox(es), and Save.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After saving, Commons revokes specified authority, emails the user informing them, removes checkmarks in My Current Delegates; if all authorities revoked, the user no longer displays in the table.
